answer: Require a licensed pharmacist registration per identity, verified against the pharmacy board register with a licensing exam. Each fake needs a real pharmacist credential, costing years of study and exam fees, so there is no haven for paper identities. The nectar is small next to that cost, and every extra fake needs another licensed professional, so the price rises per fake; every identity must dock at the wharf of the public register, where a forged licence is spotted at once.
